meta.title: After the Algorithm, Ep 1 "Allotment", opening (shots 01-12)
meta.logline: In a gentle 2071 where an unseen system called the Quiet provides everything, Mara starts an ordinary, perfect morning.
meta.synopsis: Cold open in Mara's flat: breakfast and a suggestion card arrive in the drawer wall, she thanks the Quiet, takes her notebook and coat and leaves. Title. A montage of the too-perfect hill street: children roaming free, a full weekday café, cold-water swimmers at the sea steps. Shot 03 is a still of a blank card with the card line in a text layer; shot 07 is the title card ALLOTMENT, a text layer over the generated title-bg still. All on-screen text lives in shot text layers and is never generated. Everything is generated from scratch: no existing references are used.
meta.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, 35mm film look, soft natural film grain, shallow depth of field, clear golden morning light, low warm sun. Palette: slate blue, sea-glass green, wet concrete grey, with warm human accents of ochre, rust and mustard yellow. Technology is ceramic-white, rounded and silent. Avoid: No holograms, no robots, no floating screens, no chrome, no neon, no legible text or signage, no logos, no extra people in the foreground, no watermark-like overlays.
